slots.name: honorary chair count
slots.sentence: Trump is the seventh U.S. president to serve as honorary chairman of the Presidents Cup, joining Joe Biden , Barack Obama, George W. Bush, Bill Clinton, George H.W. Bush and Gerald Ford.

slots.name: team size
slots.sentence: The Presidents Cup is a team tournament featuring 12 golfers from the United States and 12 from around the world.

slots.name: other chairmen
slots.sentence: There have been six other U.S. presidents to hold the role of honorary chairman at the Presidents Cup: Joe Biden , Barack Obama, George W. Bush, Bill Clinton, George H.W. Bush and Gerald Ford.
